notice.en: Banco Andino is a synthetic bank. Its book and capital are calibrated to public aggregates (the CMF system aggregates of August 2026, the Banco Santander-Chile Form 20-F 2025 as ratios only); the satellites are fitted on United States data and applied to it, a US-calibrated adaptation; every figure is a result of the stated method and no claim about a real bank.

basis.en: The Rosenberg and Schuermann benchmark: market-credit 0.5, market and credit with operational 0.2 (05 l.360); IRRBB is treated as a market-type risk (0.5 with credit and market, 0.2 with operational): UNVERIFIED, no dossier gives an IRRBB correlation; the dependence band shows what it changes (decision T2)
basis.es: La referencia de Rosenberg y Schuermann: mercado-crédito 0,5, mercado y crédito con operacional 0,2 (05 l.360); el IRRBB se trata como un riesgo de tipo mercado (0,5 con crédito y mercado, 0,2 con operacional): NO VERIFICADO, ningún dossier da una correlación del IRRBB; la banda de dependencia muestra lo que cambia (decisión T2)

basis.en: Degrees of freedom of the t copula: 4, 8 and 30 (30 approaches the Gaussian copula); a convention of the case, G.5 asks for several nu (05 l.378)
basis.es: Degrees of freedom of the t copula: 4, 8 and 30 (30 approaches the Gaussian copula); a convention of the case, G.5 asks for several nu (05 l.378)

statement.en: The engine's grouped copula on the six C07 segments, each a group of representative names that carry the segment's exposure, PD, LGD and asset correlation (one systematic factor); the accounts number 171,500, which no simulation of 10^6 scenarios could carry name by name. The 99.9 percent VaR and ES were measured with 400 and with 1,600 names per segment and the same seed: VaR 298,227 and 297,004 (difference -1,223), ES 346,949 and 343,791 (difference -3,158), the Monte Carlo standard error of the difference 2,262 for the VaR and 2,863 for the ES. The difference does not exceed two standard errors, so 400 names per segment are used.
statement.es: La cópula agrupada del motor sobre los seis segmentos de C07, cada uno un grupo de nombres representativos que llevan la exposición, PD, LGD y correlación de activos del segmento (un factor sistemático); las cuentas son 171.500. El VaR y el ES al 99,9 por ciento se midieron con 400 y con 1,600 nombres por segmento y la misma semilla: VaR 298,227 y 297,004 (diferencia -1,223), ES 346,949 y 343,791 (diferencia -3,158), error estándar de Monte Carlo de la diferencia 2,262 para el VaR y 2,863 para el ES. La diferencia no excede dos errores estándar, por lo que se usan 400 nombres por segmento.

statement.en: C11's mixed-portfolio VaR and ES of the last forecast day, moved from 99 percent and one day to 99.9 percent and one year by the normal quantile ratio and the square root of 250 (two conventions), and scaled to the market share of RWA: the position value is taken as the market RWA of Banco Andino. The expected loss is zero (a zero-mean return).
statement.es: El VaR y el ES de la cartera mixta de C11 del último día de pronóstico, llevados de 99 por ciento y un día a 99,9 por ciento y un año por la razón de cuantiles normales y la raíz cuadrada de 250 (dos convenciones), y escalados a la parte de APR de mercado: el valor de la posición se toma como el APR de mercado de Banco Andino. La pérdida esperada es cero (un retorno de media cero).

tests.h0: the aggregate is not above the simple sum and agrees with the variance-covariance formula
tests.alternative: the aggregate is above the simple sum or departs from the variance-covariance formula
tests.reference: dossier 05 G.5 (validation tests of an economic capital model: benchmark the aggregation against the simple sum and the variance-covariance formula, the copula-choice sensitivity, worst-case bounds, the correlation stress, the sign of every diversification benefit, one horizon and confidence level); dossier 05 G.1 (the aggregation ladder: simple sum, variance-covariance, copulas)

tests.h0: the choice between the Gaussian and the t copula over the stated nu set moves the capital by less than the thresholds
tests.alternative: the copula choice moves the capital by more than the thresholds
tests.reference: dossier 05 G.5 (validation tests of an economic capital model: benchmark the aggregation against the simple sum and the variance-covariance formula, the copula-choice sensitivity, worst-case bounds, the correlation stress, the sign of every diversification benefit, one horizon and confidence level); Rosenberg and Schuermann (2006), A general approach to integrated risk management with skewed, fat-tailed risks, J. Financial Economics 79(3):569-614, doi:10.1016/j.jfineco.2005.03.001 (dossier 05 G.2)

tests.h0: every row of the band lies between the lower bound and the worst case
tests.alternative: a row of the band lies outside the bracket of the lower bound and the worst case
tests.reference: dossier 05 G.5 (validation tests of an economic capital model: benchmark the aggregation against the simple sum and the variance-covariance formula, the copula-choice sensitivity, worst-case bounds, the correlation stress, the sign of every diversification benefit, one horizon and confidence level); dossier 05 G.3 (VaR is not subadditive; worst-case VaR bounds by the rearrangement algorithm of Embrechts, Puccetti and Ruschendorf 2013, doi:10.1016/j.jbankfin.2013.03.014)

tests.h0: raising the market-credit correlation does not lower the capital and raises it by less than the amber gate
tests.alternative: the capital falls when the correlation rises, or rises by more than the amber gate
tests.reference: dossier 05 G.5 (validation tests of an economic capital model: benchmark the aggregation against the simple sum and the variance-covariance formula, the copula-choice sensitivity, worst-case bounds, the correlation stress, the sign of every diversification benefit, one horizon and confidence level)

tests.h0: every diversification benefit has the right sign (DF <= 1)
tests.alternative: a diversified row is above the simple sum (DF > 1)
tests.reference: dossier 05 G.5 (validation tests of an economic capital model: benchmark the aggregation against the simple sum and the variance-covariance formula, the copula-choice sensitivity, worst-case bounds, the correlation stress, the sign of every diversification benefit, one horizon and confidence level); dossier 05 G.3 (VaR is not subadditive; worst-case VaR bounds by the rearrangement algorithm of Embrechts, Puccetti and Ruschendorf 2013, doi:10.1016/j.jbankfin.2013.03.014)

tests.h0: one risk horizon and one confidence level apply across the marginals
tests.alternative: a marginal is at another horizon or confidence level
tests.reference: dossier 05 G.5 (validation tests of an economic capital model: benchmark the aggregation against the simple sum and the variance-covariance formula, the copula-choice sensitivity, worst-case bounds, the correlation stress, the sign of every diversification benefit, one horizon and confidence level); dossier 01 l.837-839 (one horizon and one confidence level for the aggregation)

tests.h0: the Euler contributions add up to the total
tests.alternative: the contributions do not add up to the total
tests.reference: Tasche (2008), Capital allocation to business units and sub-portfolios: the Euler principle, arXiv 0708.2542 (full allocation); dossier 05 G.5 (validation tests of an economic capital model: check the allocation sums to the total, the sensitivity checks)

tests.h0: the Monte Carlo capital agrees with the variance-covariance anchor within z standard errors in the elliptical case
tests.alternative: the Monte Carlo capital departs from the variance-covariance anchor by more than z standard errors
tests.reference: dossier 05 G.5 (validation tests of an economic capital model: benchmark the aggregation against the simple sum and the variance-covariance formula, the copula-choice sensitivity, worst-case bounds, the correlation stress, the sign of every diversification benefit, one horizon and confidence level); dossier 05 G.1 (the aggregation ladder: simple sum, variance-covariance, copulas)

tests.h0: none to reject: the additive approximation typically overestimates risk by about 30 to 40 percent
tests.alternative: a reference, not a hypothesis test
tests.reference: Rosenberg and Schuermann (2006), A general approach to integrated risk management with skewed, fat-tailed risks, J. Financial Economics 79(3):569-614, doi:10.1016/j.jfineco.2005.03.001 (dossier 05 G.2); the figure is a reference beside the result, never a gate
tests.notes: the additive overestimate 0.3376 lies inside the published range [0.3, 0.4]

title.en: The headline capital is the simple sum, CLP 658,046 million. The dependence band runs from CLP 118,518 million (best case) to CLP 823,332 million (worst case); the Gaussian copula figure is 25.2% below the sum and is information, not capital.
title.es: El capital principal es la suma simple, CLP 658.046 millones. La banda de dependencia va de CLP 118.518 millones (mejor caso) a CLP 823.332 millones (peor caso); la cifra de la cópula gaussiana está 25,2% bajo la suma y es información, no capital.

title.en: The aggregation model moves the figure by up to 67.4% over the Gaussian copula (the Barrieu and Scandolo add-on): sensitivity information for the validator, never capital.
title.es: El modelo de agregación mueve la cifra hasta 67,4% sobre la cópula gaussiana (el recargo de Barrieu y Scandolo): información de sensibilidad para el validador, nunca capital.

title.en: The additive approximation exceeds the Gaussian copula figure by 33.8%; the published range of 30 to 40 percent is a reference and no gate.
title.es: La aproximación aditiva excede la cifra de la cópula gaussiana en 33,8%; el rango publicado de 30 a 40 por ciento es una referencia y no una barrera.
